candidateDirections.name: Rollout-transcript liveness parser (sibling detect-active-bg-codex.js)
candidateDirections.summary: New sibling detector parses the codex rollout JSONL for backgrounded unified-exec sessions ('Process running with session ID N' active vs await-correlated 'Process exited with code' dead), current-turn freshness scoping, cmd-via-call_id infra filter; stop.js widens the engine gate to copilot|codex and dispatches by engine.

candidateDirections.name: Structured manifest-tracked bg sessions via codex Pre/PostToolUse hooks
candidateDirections.summary: Record exec_command bg-session starts/exits into the actor manifest from crews' codex hooks and have the gate read manifest state; immune to output-format drift but needs codex-side changes (PostToolUse lacks still-running session metadata and async exits fire no PostToolUse), so higher effort / partly infeasible without upstreaming.

candidateDirections.name: Minimal fresh-await-proof gate (freshness reframe)
candidateDirections.summary: Require a progress turn to carry a fresh, current-turn non-infra liveness proof (ideally an await_background_completion 'still running'); never carry a bare exec_command 'running' across turns. Not a separate architecture — it is the soundness-correcting freshness rule folded into D-001.
